# BlackMail - Temporary & Disposable Email Service

> BlackMail is a fast, privacy-focused, and secure temporary email service. Generate disposable email addresses instantly with zero sign-up or registration.

## Core Features
- **Instant Temp Mail Generation**: Create temporary email addresses in one click.
- **Privacy Protection**: Avoid spam, phishing, and tracking by keeping your real email private.
- **Auto-Deletion**: Emails automatically expire and are wiped safely from servers.
- **No Registration Required**: No passwords, phone numbers, or personal data collected.
- **API Access**: Access disposable email mailboxes programmatically via API endpoints.

## Main Pages
- [Home Page](https://blackmail.pcodes.tech/): Generate temporary emails and view live inbox.
- [Blog](https://blackmail.pcodes.tech/blog): Articles on email privacy, disposable emails, and online security.
- [Policy & Privacy](https://blackmail.pcodes.tech/policy): Terms of service, privacy guarantee, and usage guidelines.
- [Links](https://blackmail.pcodes.tech/links): Community links and developer contacts.

## API References
- `GET /api/temp`: Generate a new disposable email address and session token.
- `GET /api/contact`: Send support or contact inquiries.
- `GET /api/blog`: Fetch latest blog posts from Notion integration.
- `GET /api/blog/:id`: Fetch specific blog post details and content.

## Technical Details
- Built with Next.js 16 (App Router), React 18, and Docker.
- Hosted Domain: https://blackmail.pcodes.tech
